title: The Machine of Station Meridian
author: Sable Delacroix
blurb: Elodie Coldharbour, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
